blockedCapabilities.name: Klarna sandbox checkout
blockedCapabilities.evidence: app/api/create-klarna-session/route.ts sends to Klarna's production API host with credentials embedded in source; it is not a verified sandbox integration and must not be called by the weekly suite.

blockedCapabilities.name: Global maintenance data destination
blockedCapabilities.evidence: Price research, backup/restore, and storage cleanup need a separate real database/storage destination with matching schema; no verified destination is configured in this plan.

blockedCapabilities.name: Interactive OAuth, email-link, and wallet sessions
blockedCapabilities.evidence: Unattended real OAuth providers, routable verification/reset mailboxes, a wallet extension, and test-network accounts are not configured for browser journeys.
